meta.title: Relgari Train Tickets
meta.description: A friendlier way to book train tickets in Bangladesh. Search trains, pick your seat on a clear coach map and carry a QR ticket on your phone.

hero.badgeText: A calmer way to book trains
hero.lead: Search, pick your exact seat on a clear coach map, pay, and carry a QR ticket on your phone. Built for Bangladesh's railways, in Bangla and English.

search.title: Where are you going?
search.pickStation: Choose both stations from the list.
search.searching: Searching {from} to {to} on {date} in {cls}. The results screen is the next page to design.

ticket.title: Relgari E-Ticket
ticket.gateNote: Works offline. Sample ticket for the design concept.

departures.title: See what is running, at a glance
departures.body: A departure board that reads like the station, with seats left per class so you decide before you tap.
departures.note: Times above are sample content for this design concept, not a live timetable.

seats.title: Pick seats like you pick a cinema seat
seats.body: A preview of the coach map. Tap a seat to see how selection looks. Booking starts from the search at the top.

points.t: Free, selected and sold seats look different, so you never guess.
Spot seats side by side at a glance.
Coach and class are shown right above the map.

seats.note: Preview only. Seats are not reserved here.

how.title: Four stops from search to ticket

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Choose where you are going and when.

steps.title: Pick a train
steps.text: Compare times, classes and seats left.

steps.title: Choose seats
steps.text: Tap your seats on the coach map.

steps.title: Get your QR
steps.text: Pay and your ticket is ready on your phone.

cta.title: Ready for a smoother journey?
cta.text: Start with a search. It takes less than a minute.

footer.tagline: A friendlier way to book train tickets. রেলে ভ্রমণ হোক সহজ।
footer.fine: Relgari is a personal concept project. It is not affiliated with Bangladesh Railway, and no real tickets are sold.
